title_zh: Ideas and viewpoints — 第35节可背诵讲义
body_en: Ideas can differ and still be useful. Listen first, then explain your reason. Use facts, examples, and clear words. Change your mind when new facts appear — that shows real power, not weakness. Write both sides of a topic before you choose.
body_zh: 想法可以不同却仍有用。先听，再说明理由。使用事实、例子和清楚的词语。有新事实时改变想法——那显示真正的力量，不是软弱。选题前先写下正反两面。
